transfer_credit_time_limit.official_policy: SNHU does not publish a blanket time limit for transfer credits from regionally accredited institutions.
transfer_credit_time_limit.practical_guidance: Credits are evaluated on course content and grade (C or better). Some technical courses may be flagged as outdated at advisor discretion.

paulo_assessment.degree: Estácio de Sá — Information Technology Management (Tecnólogo)
paulo_assessment.rationale: 8-year-old IT management degree is within normal acceptance range. SNHU transfer advisors typically flag recency only for rapidly-evolving subjects like specific programming languages or security tools. IT management and operations fundamentals remain valid. WES evaluation does not expire.
risk_courses: CCT0783 — Delivery and Support in IT (ITIL version may be dated)
CCT0746 — Software Development Processes (Agile/DevOps specifics may be updated)

ba_it_to_ms_transfer.question: Do BA in IT credits reduce MS Cybersecurity or MS IT requirements?
ba_it_to_ms_transfer.answer: NO — undergraduate credits do not reduce graduate course requirements.
ba_it_to_ms_transfer.detail: The BA in IT credential satisfies the bachelor's degree admission requirement for the MS programs. The 90 transfer credits used to complete the BA do not carry forward into the MS. SNHU may accept up to 12 graduate transfer credits if the student has prior graduate-level coursework from an accredited institution.

paulo_graduate_credit_potential.source: PUC Minas — AI & ML Postgraduate Specialization (in progress, 2025-2027)
paulo_graduate_credit_potential.note: Once completed, PUC Minas coursework (WES-evaluated) may qualify for up to 12 graduate transfer credits toward MS Cybersecurity or MS IT. Confirm with SNHU graduate admissions.

ms_cybersecurity.admission_requirement: Bachelor's degree from regionally accredited institution

ms_it_it_concentration.program: MS in Information Technology — IT Concentration (MS.IT)
ms_it_it_concentration.admission_requirement: Bachelor's degree from regionally accredited institution
ms_it_it_concentration.comparison_vs_ms_cybersecurity: MS IT is broader and more technical (OOP, databases, OS). MS Cybersecurity is more strategically aligned with Paulo's cert stack (ISC2, Security+, CCNA) and CISO career track. MS Cybersecurity recommended as primary path.
